note: Curated market-level headlines, drafted from real events in plain words: no company names, people, places, years or era-specific terms. Months not listed get a plain line generated from the market's return that month (lib/markets/data/headlines.ts). Every entry is reviewed:false until Max checks it; 'flag' marks a draft that is unsure of the month, the fact or the wording. Nothing after 2025 is drafted (no reliable knowledge yet); those months are generated.
